description: This file defines the SiloConnectionOptions class within the Orleans.Configuration namespace, which provides configuration options for silo networking connections, including methods to configure inbound and outbound connections for silos and gateways. It also contains an internal interface ISiloConnectionBuilderOptions defining the configuration methods for connection builders.

classes.name: SiloConnectionOptions
classes.description: Class providing configuration options for silo networking in Orleans, including delegates for inbound/outbound connection configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloOutboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo outbound connections using a provided delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloInboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo inbound connections from other silos.

methods.name: ConfigureGatewayInboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo inbound connections from clients via the gateway.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloOutboundBuilder
methods.description: Configured via interface, invoked to set up outbound connection builder.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloInboundBuilder
methods.description: Configured via interface, invoked to set up inbound connection builder.

methods.name: ConfigureGatewayInboundBuilder
methods.description: Configured via interface, invoked to set up gateway inbound connection builder.
